proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9188 bahukāra explicitly gives Prakrit baühārī/bohārī brush and Punjabi/Lahnda bahārī/bohārī/buhārā broom, with Sindhi bauārī in the addendum. Selected bahari/bairi/buar responses match this documented broom family. Vowel contraction, aspiration migration or loss, glide realization and inflection remain qualified and unchanged; the link does not settle local IA transmission. Extra-n formations and highly contracted forms are excluded. Exact response: beheri.
